description: Full längd 16S rRNA-gen långläsning sekvensering från torkad cervicovaginal vätska is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Uppsala universitet. This dataset refers to the 16S rRNA gene long-read sequencing data described in the article "Full-length multiplexed 16S rRNA gene sequencing works well in self-collected decade old cervicovaginal fluid on paper cards" (unpublished). Coverage: Uppsala universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Full-length 16S rRNA gene long-read sequencing from dried cervicovaginal fluid" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Uppsala universitet. Its keywords include Microbial genetics, Genomics and transcriptomics, Translational and applied bioinformatics. The listing shows 2025-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
